类 ItemStack

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack
所有已实现的接口:
Cloneable, HoverEventSource<HoverEvent.ShowItem>, ConfigurationSerializable
public class ItemStack extends Object implements Cloneable, ConfigurationSerializable, HoverEventSource<HoverEvent.ShowItem>

    • addEnchantments

      public void addEnchantments(Map<Enchantment,Integer> enchantments)
      Adds the specified enchantments to this item stack. 向该物品堆添加指定的附魔。

      This method is the same as calling addEnchantment(org.bukkit.enchantments.Enchantment, int) for each element of the map. 此方法等价于对映射中的每个元素调用 addEnchantment(org.bukkit.enchantments.Enchantment, int)。

      参数:
      enchantments - Enchantments to add 要添加的附魔
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the specified enchantments is null 若指定的附魔为 null
      IllegalArgumentException - if any specific enchantment or level is null. Warning: Some enchantments may be added before this exception is thrown. 若任何具体的附魔或等级为 null。警告：在抛出此异常前，部分附魔可能已被添加。

    • addEnchantment

      public void addEnchantment(Enchantment ench, int level)
      Adds the specified Enchantment to this item stack.

      If this item stack already contained the given enchantment (at any level), it will be replaced. 如果该物品堆已包含给定的附魔（任意等级），它将被替换。

      参数:
      ench - Enchantment to add 要添加的附魔
      level - Level of the enchantment 附魔的等级
      抛出:
      IllegalArgumentException - if enchantment null, or enchantment is not applicable 若附魔为 null，或附魔不适用

    • addUnsafeEnchantments

      public void addUnsafeEnchantments(Map<Enchantment,Integer> enchantments)
      Adds the specified enchantments to this item stack in an unsafe manner. 以不安全的方式向该物品堆添加指定的附魔。

      This method is the same as calling addUnsafeEnchantment(org.bukkit.enchantments.Enchantment, int) for each element of the map. 此方法等价于对映射中的每个元素调用 addUnsafeEnchantment(org.bukkit.enchantments.Enchantment, int)。

      参数:
      enchantments - Enchantments to add 要添加的附魔

    • addUnsafeEnchantment

      public void addUnsafeEnchantment(Enchantment ench, int level)
      Adds the specified Enchantment to this item stack. 向该物品堆添加指定的 Enchantment。

      If this item stack already contained the given enchantment (at any level), it will be replaced. 如果该物品堆已包含给定的附魔（任意等级），它将被替换。

      This method is unsafe and will ignore level restrictions or item type. Use at your own discretion. 此方法是不安全的，将忽略等级限制和物品类型。请自行斟酌使用。

      参数:
      ench - Enchantment to add 要添加的附魔
      level - Level of the enchantment 附魔的等级

      public int removeEnchantment(Enchantment ench)

      返回:
